caption:
How are hedge funds using AI? They aren't just typing prompts into chatbots.

Asset manager Balyasny Asset Management built an AI research engine by combining continuous model evaluation, full-platform OpenAI integration, and autonomous agent workflows.

In high-stakes industries like institutional finance, accuracy is everything. Moving from simple chat tools to agentic systems requires strict evaluation pipelines—ensuring models deliver verifiable research before driving capital decisions.

Swipe through for the breakdown on how autonomous agents are reshaping knowledge work.
